title: Gloria De beata virgine (Josquin)
desc: Josquin des Prez, Gloria De beata virgine. 3 voices (Discantus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Jos1308); encoded by Jesse Rodin. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0; converted to Cantare notation (tools/kern2cantare.py).
